row: Canine Mind is an educational channel about dog behavior, psychology and welfare, made for dog owners who want to understand what their dog is feeling and how to care for him better. Every video is based on published research in canine cognition and welfare, and every health-related topic encourages viewers to consult their veterinarian. The channel is run by Biel, who researches and writes each script together with a collaborator. Illustrations are generated from each script scene by scene, and the narration is produced with an AI voice tool; both are disclosed on every video. Sources are listed in each description.
